Arbitration is faster than courts for consumer disputes

Online arbitration of consumer disputes in India takes on average under six months, according to platform data reviewed by this newspaper.

By contrast, civil litigation in district courts commonly takes between three and five years to reach a final decree, a delay that consumer groups have long criticised.

Digital document submission has reduced administrative costs by roughly 40 percent for lenders that moved their recovery disputes online, two executives said.

Experts caution that awards may still be challenged under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, which can add months to enforcement.
